# Motiva Real Estate

> Contemporary residential architecture and development across Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt — a small portfolio of villas, apartments, penthouses, and serviced plots for buyers who ask their spaces to mean something.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview and featured residences.
- [About](/about): The studio, its people, and its approach.
- [Residences](/projects): Current portfolio with filters by city, type, beds, and price.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Interiors, exteriors, kitchens, and details from delivered residences.
- [FAQ](/faq): Buying, payments, diaspora purchase, and inspections.
- [Contact](/contact): Speak to a specialist or book a private site inspection.
